cards.ex: The documents are marked 'strictly confidential' and should not be shared.
cards.exUz: Hujjatlar 'qat'iy maxfiy' deb belgilangan va ularni hech kimga ulashmaslik kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimga aytilmasligi kerak bo'lgan, juda muhim maxfiy ma'lumot.

cards.ex: As a senior manager, she has privileged access to the company's financial data.
cards.exUz: Yuqori menejer sifatida u kompaniyaning moliyaviy ma'lumotlariga imtiyozli kirish huquqiga ega.
cards.uzDef: Faqat ma'lum odamlarga ruxsat etilgan maxsus kirish huquqi.

cards.ex: Her coding skills were our secret weapon in winning the hackathon.
cards.exUz: Uning kodlash mahorati xakatonni yutishdagi sirli qurolimiz edi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda g'alaba qozonishga yordam beradigan yashirin afzallik.

cards.ex: They're planning the surprise party on the quiet so she doesn't find out.
cards.exUz: Ular uning bilib qolmasligi uchun kutilmagan ziyofatni jimlikda rejalashtiryapti.
cards.uzDef: Ovoz chiqarmasdan, sir saqlab, e'lon qilmasdan.

cards.ex: This is a matter of discretion; please don't discuss it with anyone.
cards.exUz: Bu ehtiyotkorlik masalasi; iltimos, buni hech kim bilan muhokama qilmang.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan vaziyatda yaxshi hukm va maxfiylikni talab qiladigan narsa.

cards.ex: Everyone has a skeleton in the closet they'd rather not talk about.
cards.exUz: Har kimning shunday sirli joyi bor, u haqda gapirishni xohlamaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishda yashirilgan, uyatli yoki noqulay sir.

cards.ex: Access to classified information requires security clearance.
cards.exUz: Maxfiy ma'lumotlarga kirish xavfsizlik ruxsatini talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Hukumat yoki tashkilot tomonidan himoyalangan maxfiy ma'lumot.

cards.ex: The instructions were clear: burn after reading.
cards.exUz: Ko'rsatmalar aniq edi: o'qigandan keyin yo'qot.
cards.uzDef: O'qilgandan keyin yo'q qilinishi kerak bo'lgan maxfiy xabar.

cards.ex: Can you keep this under your hat for a few days?
cards.exUz: Buni bir necha kun davomida sir saqlay olasizmi?
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani sir saqlash, hech kimga aytmaslik.

cards.ex: I had to pull some strings to get you that internship.
cards.exUz: Sizga stajirovkani olish uchun men aralashishimga to'g'ri keldi.
cards.uzDef: Yashirincha ta'sir o'tkazish, tanish-bilishchilik orqali yordam berish.

cards.ex: The film was a cloak-and-dagger thriller.
cards.exUz: Film yashirin triller edi.
cards.uzDef: Maxfiy, josuslik va yashirin harakatlar bilan bog'liq.

cards.ex: They discovered a mole within their organization.
cards.exUz: Ular o'z tashkilotida josusni aniqladilar.
cards.uzDef: Dushman tashkilotga yashirincha kirgan josus.

cards.ex: The government had to redact the document before releasing it.
cards.exUz: Hukumat hujjatni e'lon qilishdan oldin tahrirlashi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Hujjatdagi maxfiy ma'lumotlarni olib tashlash yoki qoralash.

cards.ex: The agent went rogue and released the information to the press.
cards.exUz: Agent boshqaruvdan chiqib, ma'lumotni matbuotga tarqatdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z-o'zidan, ruxsatsiz harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I'm telling you this in the strictest confidence.
cards.exUz: Men sizga buni eng qattiq maxfiylikda aytyapman.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimga aytilmasligi sharti bilan.

cards.ex: We need to keep a lid on this until we're ready to announce it.
cards.exUz: Buni e'lon qilishga tayyor bo'lgunimizcha nazorat ostida saqlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani sir saqlash, tarqalishiga yo'l qo'ymaslik.

cards.ex: It takes time for people to open up about their past.
cards.exUz: Odamlarga o'z o'tmishlari haqida dardlashishi uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy his-tuyg'ularni, sirlarni ochib aytmoq.

cards.ex: The emails are considered privileged communication and cannot be used as evidence.
cards.exUz: Elektron pochta xabarlari maxsus muloqot hisoblanadi va dalil sifatida ishlatilishi mumkin emas.
cards.uzDef: Qonuniy himoyaga ega bo'lgan shaxsiy muloqot, masalan, advokat va mijoz o'rtasida.

cards.ex: He promised to take the secret to the grave.
cards.exUz: U sirni qabristonga olib ketishga va'da berdi.
cards.uzDef: Sirni hech kimga aytmasdan o'lish.

cards.ex: The judge ordered the hearing to be held in camera.
cards.exUz: Sudya eshituvni yopiq sud majlisida o'tkazishga buyruq berdi.
cards.uzDef: Ommadan yopiq bo'lgan sud majlisi.

cards.ex: She testified under oath that she had never met him.
cards.exUz: U qasamyod ostida hech qachon u bilan uchrashmaganligini aytdi.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri gapirishga va'da berib, rasmiy ravishda guvohlik berish.

cards.ex: The contract arrived in a sealed envelope.
cards.exUz: Shartnoma muhrlangan konvertda keldi.
cards.uzDef: Ochilganligini ko'rsatadigan muhr bilan berkitilgan konvert.

cards.ex: They suspected that their office was bugged.
cards.exUz: Ular o'z ofislari tinglangan deb gumon qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Xonaga yashirincha tinglash moslamasini o'rnatish.

cards.ex: The survey guaranteed complete anonymity for participants.
cards.exUz: So'rov ishtirokchilar uchun to'liq anonimlikni kafolatladi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning noma'lumligini ta'minlash holati.

cards.ex: He was rumored to be a member of a secret society.
cards.exUz: U yashirin jamiyat a'zosi ekanligi haqida mish-mishlar tarqaldi.
cards.uzDef: A'zolari va faoliyati sir saqlanadigan tashkilot.

cards.ex: The politician stonewalled when asked about the scandal.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi janjal haqida so'ralganda javob berishdan bosh tortdi.
cards.uzDef: Savollarga javob berishdan bosh tortish, to'siq qo'yish.

cards.ex: I'll keep mum about your little secret.
cards.exUz: Men sening kichik siring haqida jim bo'laman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida jim bo'lish, aytmaslik.

cards.ex: The new law protects personal data from unauthorized access.
cards.exUz: Yangi qonun shaxsiy ma'lumotlarni ruxsatsiz kirishdan himoya qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsni aniqlash uchun ishlatilishi mumkin bo'lgan ma'lumotlar.

cards.ex: The company launched a discreet inquiry to find out who was leaking information to the press.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya matbuotga kim ma'lumot sizdirayotganini aniqlash uchun maxfiy surishtiruv boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Birovga sezilmaydigan, maxfiy tekshiruv yoki so'rov o'tkazish.

cards.ex: All employees are required to sign an agreement to maintain confidentiality regarding client details.
cards.exUz: Barcha xodimlar mijozlar tafsilotlari bo'yicha maxfiylikni saqlash to'g'risidagi bitimni imzolashlari kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maxfiy ma'lumotlarni oshkor qilmaslik, sir saqlash.
